title: STS(15) 的 Pasch-switch 商图：确定 79 点连通分量的直径
confidence_basis: The complete 80-vertex quotient graph was reconstructed exactly and replayed by a no-nauty verifier using a different Pasch enumerator and explicit Steiner-quasigroup isomorphisms. A standalone BFS verifier confirms diameter 11. All six corruptions are rejected. The remaining 1% reflects reliance on the classical published 80-class completeness theorem and the necessarily bounded priority search.
summary: The simple Pasch-switch quotient has 258 edges and components 79+1. The 79-vertex component has diameter 11 and radius 6; the isolated vertex is V036. Exactly two unordered pairs attain the diameter: V000-V006 and V000-V028.
author: Zijian Zeng
